scripts.prisma:generate: prisma generate --schema prisma/main && prisma generate --schema prisma/log
scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: APP_ENV=${APP_ENV:-develop} pnpm -w run hansapp-cli db migrate --db main
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: APP_ENV=${APP_ENV:-develop} pnpm -w run hansapp-cli db deploy --db main
scripts.prisma:migrate:status: APP_ENV=${APP_ENV:-develop} pnpm -w run hansapp-cli db status --db main
scripts.prisma:migrate:log:deploy: APP_ENV=${APP_ENV:-develop} pnpm -w run hansapp-cli db deploy --db log
scripts.prisma:migrate:log:dev: APP_ENV=${APP_ENV:-develop} pnpm -w run hansapp-cli db migrate --db log
